summary: Iteration 9 testing: Backend all green (about_zones=5, gallery-eventi has 9 media, admin PUT reorder+add zone works and persists, restore ok). Admin Contenuti tab zone editor fully functional (add-zone-btn appends zone-editor-5, all per-zone testids present). Regression club-preview-section on Home shows 4 club-zone-card-* correctly. CRITICAL BUG: the promised new Home section 'home-gallery-preview' is NOT rendered — Home.jsx has the galleryPreview state + useEffect fetch, but the JSX <section data-testid='home-gallery-preview'> block was never added between club-preview-section (ends line 267) and shop-preview-section (starts line 270). grep on Home.jsx confirms zero matches for 'home-gallery'. Feature '(1) Anteprima Tab Su Home' is therefore not delivered on the frontend.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing JSX section for home-gallery-preview. State galleryPreview is set (up to 4 items fetched from /media?category=gallery-eventi) but no <section data-testid='home-gallery-preview'> is rendered. As a result: no 'Uno sguardo dentro' heading, no home-gallery-cta, no home-gallery-item-0..3 tiles. Feature is completely invisible on Home.

action_items: Add the missing JSX section in /app/frontend/src/pages/Home.jsx between club-preview-section closing and shop-preview-section opening (around line 268). Section should: use data-testid='home-gallery-preview'; render only if galleryPreview.length > 0; include heading 'Uno sguardo dentro'; kicker showing settings?.about_gallery_groups?.[0]?.title; a Link to /il-club with data-testid='home-gallery-cta' ('Scopri il Club'); a responsive grid (grid-cols-2 on mobile, lg:grid-cols-4) of exactly 4 aspect-square tiles wrapped as Link to /il-club with data-testid={`home-gallery-item-${i}`}; each src must resolve absolute URL (prefix REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL when path starts with '/').

About_zones reseed via startup patcher works; consider making seed idempotent-on-empty rather than a startup one-off patcher, so future accidental wipes recover.

rca of the issue: In this iteration's edit to Home.jsx, only the data-fetching layer (const [galleryPreview, setGalleryPreview] = useState([]) and its useEffect that calls /media with the first about_gallery_groups category) was added. The JSX rendering block that displays those 4 items was not committed. grep 'home-gallery' /app/frontend/src/pages/Home.jsx returns no matches, and the live DOM confirms 0 elements. Fix: append the JSX section as described in action_items.
